careless_big_five: This means acting on the moment: leaving things in a mess, showing up late, bending the rules, settling for whatever gets by, and dropping a task once it gets hard.
emotionally_stable_big_five: This means staying calm and even-tempered: expecting things to turn out, slow to anger, quick to shake off gloom, at ease among strangers, passing up temptations, and steady under stress.
open_hexaco: This means losing oneself in a painting or a landscape, curious about many fields of knowledge, letting imagination run through an ordinary day, and being drawn to strange ideas and odd people.
closed_big_five: This means sticking to the tried-and-true: calling daydreams a waste of time, shrugging at art, paying feelings no mind, following the same routine, leaving ideas to others, and keeping one's inherited beliefs.
